_help: Every word shown on screen, in all six languages: one key -> six values (en, hi, ta, te, kn, ml). Text that still needs a native speaker starts with "[TRANSLATE] " followed by the English; replace the whole value (including the [TRANSLATE] tag) with the real translation. {s} and {n} are numbers filled in by the app: keep them. Keys starting with _ are notes. Tip: python3 scripts/strings_csv.py export makes a spreadsheet translators can fill in. After editing run: python3 scripts/check_config.py
